# stripe_metronome_offset_notification (Resource)

An offset lifecycle notification configuration. Import by ID. Destroy archives it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `policy` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy))

### Optional

- `uniqueness_key` (String) Optional API idempotency key. GET omits it; an import can only record the configured value locally. Give a replacement a different key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy`

Required:

- `offset` (String) ISO-8601 duration; negative for before the event. Changes replace the configuration because the current edit endpoint rejects offset policies.
- `type` (String) Lifecycle event type from LifecycleEventOffsetPolicy.
